how is this NR and FNR working in case of more than two files??

posts.name: 22F2001240
posts.cooked:
NR will continue numbering through out the action works even if it is from different files. FNR will reset the record number into 1 for each file
For example: If you have 2 files , file1 contains 10 records (lines) and file 2 contains 10 records and passing as the order file1 followed by file2 then,
NR for first line of file2 is 11
FNR for first line of file2 is 1
